'''Duffit's Estate''' was the residence of [[Stanfeld Duffit]], [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] of [[Montrol City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Duffit hosted a dinner party for business leaders and a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] delegation from the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]''.
